note:
account: six hooks stopped being helpers too.

Four had no override anywhere and were split the way ADR-0051 prescribes -- the hook keeps its name and delegates to a helper the other callers use (_compute_tax_country_id, _compute_split_sequence, _inverse_analytic_distribution, _compute_code).

Two do have overrides (l10n_ec_edi and l10n_uy_edi extend account.move._compute_name; point_of_sale and l10n_ec_edi extend _compute_amounts), so a split would have let a direct caller skip the override. Those call sites went through env.add_to_compute() instead, which dispatches through the field and respects the MRO -- already the idiom in this file at account_move.py. The two remaining callers of _compute_name lived in l10n_it_edi and l10n_latam_invoice_document and moved the same way.

24 -> 18.

Command: python tooling/architecture/field_hook_purity.py --count
